acceptance_criteria.requirement: Compare InMemory with at least one persistent or simulated persistent backend.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: at least 2 enabled backends, including 1 persistent backend

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Detect every injected inconsistency in the 10 public replay cases.
Keep the false-positive rate for normal cases at or below 5%.
Detect summary loss, overwrite-lineage errors and session ownership errors.
Locate every diff by session, field path, values, and event or summary identity.
Complete lightweight mode within 30 seconds; integrations may be skipped.

implementation_profile.adapter_lifecycle: Backend setup, replay, restart, snapshot and close are isolated behind adapters.
implementation_profile.persistence_restart: Persistent adapters close and reopen services before their final read-back.
implementation_profile.summary_lineage: Summary content and session_id/summary_id/version/replaces are compared separately.
implementation_profile.multi_session_snapshot: Every named session alias is retained in sessions_by_alias.
implementation_profile.memory_observations: Memory reads retain query name, session alias and replay step index.
implementation_profile.allowed_diff_governance: Rules require reasons, may scope backend pairs and cannot mask summary lineage.
implementation_profile.raw_storage_injection: SQLite and optional Redis can be corrupted below the SDK boundary.
implementation_profile.exact_acceptance_metrics: Expected, detected, missing and unexpected paths are reported independently.

backend_statuses.name: redis
backend_statuses.reason: Set TRPC_AGENT_REPLAY_REDIS_URL to enable Redis integration mode.

cases.description: Single-turn replay must detect an injected event author mismatch.
Multi-turn replay must detect an injected event text mismatch at its exact index.
Tool replay must detect an injected function-call name mismatch.
State replay must detect an injected overwritten preference.
Memory replay must detect an injected loss of persisted search results.
Summary replay must detect an injected semantic content mismatch.

cases.description: Summary replay must detect an injected version rollback.
Injected summary ownership mismatch must be reported at the exact summary field path.
Injected summary loss must be detected as a summary-level mismatch.

cases.description: Injected summary lineage corruption must be detected via the replaces field.
A duplicated event injected during replay must be detected as an event-count mismatch.
A runtime state corruption must be detected on the precise state path.
A runtime summary deletion must be detected as a missing summary.

cases.description: A runtime summary overwrite must be detected through lineage replacement fields.
A partial failure that loses the final event but keeps state must be detected as an event-window mismatch.
A runtime summary deletion on a non-active session alias must still be detected through alias-scoped snapshots.

cases.description: Memory written by one session should remain searchable from another session under the same app/user scope.
Persistent backends should restore summary state correctly after a restart and continue replaying later turns.
App, user, session, and temp state should preserve their intended visibility across sessions and restarts.
Memory saved for one user must not become visible to another user in the same application.
